calls.title: Smalls & Growthbook ROI Discussion
calls.summary: The sales team addresses various challenges regarding deal progress, particularly with technical issues affecting momentum on key deals like Groupon’s proof of concept. They discuss upgrading 33 legacy accounts to enterprise plans to prevent revenue leakage caused by outdated pricing. The team emphasizes the importance of internal support to resolve client issues quickly, as clients face system-related challenges. The meeting reflects a positive team culture, with a focus on flexibility in scheduling and a collective adaptation to early calls. Additionally, there’s a strong focus on enforcing new pricing strategies to eliminate discounts and enhance the company's market position, thereby reflecting a shift towards valuing the product and the customers significantly.
calls.keywords: enterprise accounts, agency support, event forwarding, revenue leakage, legacy pricing, technical issues
